description: Standalone wrapper for the pool_peer_500ms agent. Previously this config existed only inline in scripts/arena_config_champion_gauntlet*.json; extracted here so the champion gauntlet can load it as a first-class candidate. This is the same-budget (500 ms) MCTS peer with progressive widening + Layer 9 meta-optimization but NO opponent modeling, which has historically out-rated champion_v1 (TrueSkill mu=50.55 anchor on the 2026-05-14 run). Matches the pool_peer_500ms definition in scripts/arena_config_champion_gauntlet_v2.json.
